text:
maggie: Quick heads-up — ran into two 404s while stepping through the Model Onboarding runbook checklist. Found an S3 screenshot missing and an external gist shortlink that 404s. Can someone take a tiny PR? low priority but blocks onboarding for one new hire today :grimacing:

linkchecker-bot: scan report: 2 failures in /handbooks/model-onboarding.md
- line ~98: https://s3.console.aws/.../onboarding-screenshot.png -> 403
- line ~214: https://short.io/r/abcd -> 404
(full output: https://internal.tools/link-scan/scan/1743210000)

sam: I can pick this up. Do we want to rehost the screenshot in /assets/docs/ or just update to the canonical S3 signed URL?

maggie: Prefer rehost to assets/docs so it survives lifecycle. Path: /static/assets/docs/onboarding/onboarding-screenshot.png
Also gist: replace shortlink with raw gist URL or inline the snippet.

kira: @sam : if you rehost, ping me for quick review and I'll assign owner in frontmatter. Also check the frontmatter of that page — last editor was @ben and partial ownership is ambiguous.

sam: OK will do. Quick plan:
1) copy screenshot to docs bucket and commit path
2) replace shortlink with https://gist.github.com/realname/abcdef#file-setup-md
3) small PR w/ one-line frontmatter owners: ["ben","eng-onboarding"]
Command I'll run locally:
```
aws s3 cp ./onboarding-screenshot.png s3://redwood-docs/static/assets/docs/onboarding/onboarding-screenshot.png --acl public-read
git add docs/handbooks/model-onboarding.md
git commit -m "docs: rehost onboarding screenshot & replace shortlink"
git push && open pr
```

maggie: :thumbsup: Thanks. One more — CI doc linter is currently set to block merges if dead links are present, so once PR is up it should show up in the checks. Tag me in PR and I can merge after verification.

ben: I can spare 10m to review once the PR is up. Also, can we include a tiny note in the runbook about "assets are managed in docs bucket" so future folks know where to rehost?

sam: Sure. I'll add that in the PR body + tiny sentence in the page.

docs-deploy-bot: docs-site deployment queued by sam's PR #4321, status: pending build

maggie: Awesome — thanks everyone. If anything blocks, @kira will you take ownership?

kira: Happy to. :wave:

docs-deploy-bot: build succeeded and deployed to staging (https://staging.docs.redwood.com/handbooks/model-onboarding) — PR #4321 merged.
